name: Throwing Charge (Combat)
body:
You are skilled at flinging a missile at your foes as you charge into melee combat.

Prerequisite(s): Base Attack Bonus +1, Combat Reflexes

Benefit(s): As part of a charge action, you may make an attack with one thrown weapon at the target you are charging. This attack is at –4, and may take place from any point in your charge.
